summary: Genius Sports Limited, a UK-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim report and earnings press release for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, filed November 5, 2026 and signed by CEO Mark Locke. The filing is a routine quarterly results disclosure, not a special situation. Balance sheet highlights include cash of $206.5 million versus $280.6 million at year-end 2025, goodwill rising to $776.5 million from $338.0 million and intangibles to $744.9 million from $144.2 million, implying acquisitions during the period. No deal terms, board recommendations or advisors are stated.
